abstract: Carcinomas arising in mature cystic teratomas of the ovaries from nine women were examined for the presence of p53 mutations. The nine tumors comprised six squamous cell carcinomas, one squamous cell carcinoma in situ, one undifferentiated small cell carcinoma, and one mucoepidermoid carcinoma. Abnormal nuclear accumulation of the p53 protein was observed in four of the tumors. Genomic DNA was extracted from formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissue blocks and subjected to polymerase chain reaction (PCR) for specific amplification of the p53 gene exons 5-8, followed by direct chemiluminescence sequencing analysis. A frameshift mutation in exon 8 (codon 278, CCT > del T; stop at codon 344) was detected in one poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma. The samples were also evaluated for the possible association of 'benign' and 'malignant' types of human papillomavirus (HPV) by PCR using universal primer sets. None of the samples contained detectable HPV genome. These data suggest that p53 mutations are relatively uncommon in secondary carcinomas developing in ovarian dermoid cysts, although the number of samples studied was admittedly small.
abstract_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた癌9例について、p53変異を検討した。腫瘍は扁平上皮癌6例、扁平上皮癌in situ 1例、未分化小細胞癌1例、粘表皮癌1例であった。4例で核内p53蛋白の異常な蓄積が認められた。ホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋組織からゲノムDNAを抽出し、p53遺伝子のエクソン5〜8をPCRで特異的に増幅後、直接化学発光シーケンス解析を行った。低分化扁平上皮癌1例でエクソン8にフレームシフト変異（コドン278、CCT>del T、コドン344で終止）が検出された。ユニバーサルプライマーを用いたPCRにより「良性」と「悪性」のヒトパピローマウイルス（HPV）を評価したが、いずれの試料にもHPVゲノムは検出されなかった。これらのデータは、卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じる二次性癌ではp53変異が比較的まれであることを示唆するが、対象数は少ない。
